report.intro: Full sweep of AI and quantum/post-quantum launches for Sun Nov 1, 2026 (ET): every watchlist project rescored on the 8-factor Oracle Score, impostor checks run, new candidates screened.

report.disclaimer: The Oracle never connects wallets, signs, or trades. Scores measure disclosure and evidence, not price.
